claims: Clash Royale is a mobile real-time PvP strategy game.
Clash Royale is available for free download on iOS App Store.
Clash Royale is available for free download on Google Play.
Clash Royale matches are 3 minutes long with overtime.
Players use Elixir to deploy troop, spell, and building cards in Clash Royale.
The core objective in Clash Royale is to destroy the opponent's King Tower while defending your own.
Players create an 8-card deck from their collection in Clash Royale.
Clash Royale decks feature troops, spells, and defensive structures.
Players earn trophies by winning battles in Clash Royale.
Players earn chests by winning battles in Clash Royale.
Players earn cards by winning battles in Clash Royale.
Joining a clan allows trading cards in Clash Royale.
Players rise through different league tiers by gaining trophies in Clash Royale.
Legend League is a league in Clash Royale.
Top players in the world compete in Legend League.
Clash Royale can be downloaded from the Apple App Store by searching for "Clash Royale".
Clash Royale can be downloaded from the Google Play Store by searching for "Clash Royale".
